statistic_classes.measured_analytics: Observed operational telemetry from a configured analytics provider; must include provider/context and observation window.
statistic_classes.repository_derived: Deterministically derived from repository state; must include snapshot or release provenance.
statistic_classes.structural: Counts identifiers, URLs or records structurally; does not imply API verification, availability, truth, authorship, rights or scientific validity.
statistic_classes.verified: Requires an explicit verification method appropriate to the claim; structural presence alone is insufficient.
statistic_classes.estimate: Approximate figure; must be visibly labelled as an estimate and must not be silently promoted to an audited exact count.
